rows.note: This is the all-purpose technical term for the part nearer the point of attachment or observation, usually before a body-part noun.

example.english: During the nerve examination, we need to distinguish the proximal end from the distal end.
example.traditional: 做神經檢查時，要分清楚近端同遠端。
example.jyutping: zou6 san4 ging1 gim2 caa4 si4 jiu3 fan1 cing1 co2 gan6 dyun1 tung4 jyun5 dyun1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a tooth surface facing or touching an adjacent tooth.

example.english: The dentist said the proximal surface of my molar has decay and needs a filling.
example.traditional: 牙醫話我隻大牙嘅鄰面有蛀牙，要補返。
example.jyutping: ngaa4 ji1 waa6 ngo5 zek3 daai6 ngaa4 ge3 leon4 min6 jau5 zyu3 ngaa4 jiu3 bou2 faan2
